title: Fun and great customer service
text:
Our first box was an epic disappointment - it arrived damaged (totally smashed) and didn't include the hat and apron you are supposed to get when first subscribing. I contacted customer support via their website, and I received a response within minutes. They apologized and sent out new box which arrived two days later (this time not smashed and with hat and apron).

The kit itself was fun for the kiddo, and he enjoyed it, but I'm not sure that the price of the box is in line with the cost of ingredients. $39 to make six cupcakes seemed a little steep to me :)
